description: PAID ($0.009 USDC via x402). Which tokens just appeared or are being pushed right now: the union of DexScreener's public lists (newly created token profiles, community takeovers, and tokens whose teams paid for a boost), each with the numbers to judge it from its most liquid pair — price, liquidity, 1h and 24h volume, 24h buys and sells, 1h/24h price change, market cap, FDV, pair age and links. Filter by chain (solana, base, ethereum, bsc …; default every chain), list (new, boosted, all) and a liquidity floor (default $10k); sort by volume, liquidity, change or newest. A boost is paid promotion, not a quality signal; new tokens are high-risk — run token_safety before trading. Data, not financial advice. Without payment this returns the 402 challenge; the fiatdock-mcp npm package pays automatically. Any answer the tool cannot produce is >= 400 and is NOT charged.

payment.description: Base64 of a single x402 v2 PaymentPayload (EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization on Base USDC). OMIT it on the first call: the 402 you get back carries `howToPay.payloadTemplate` — the exact envelope to fill in — plus the price and the EIP-712 domain. Send it on the second call to complete the purchase; it is forwarded as the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header, never as body data. Nothing is charged for the 402 itself, and a call that fails after payment settles nothing.
